trap.label: generalizar / ordem
trap.wrong: For the most part she used savings, hardly had she borrowed.
trap.right: For the most part, she used savings.
trap.why: O brasileiro tende a unir orações com vírgula. Em inglês, locuções como For the most part vêm no início seguidas de vírgula.

mcq.q: Hardly ___ the meeting started when the fire alarm rang.
“For the most part,” is followed by…

opts: By and large it worked, hardly.

fix.wrong: Hardly the meeting had started when it rained.
fix.right: Hardly had the meeting started when it rained.

fix.wrong: For the most part she use savings.
fix.right: For the most part, she used savings.

rewrite.prompt: Use By and large: “In general, the plan worked.”
rewrite.answer: By and large, the plan worked.

rewrite.prompt: Comece com Hardly: “The meeting had just started when it rained.”
rewrite.answer: Hardly had the meeting started when it rained.

rewrite.prompt: Use For the most part: “Mostly, she used savings.”
rewrite.answer: For the most part, she used savings.
